checks.text: On initial load, the page displays the heading "Typing Test", a button labelled "Start Test", and the text "No test in progress".

Clicking the button "Start Test" displays a text area labelled "Passage" containing the exact text "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", a text area labelled "Input", and a timer displaying "00:00".
Typing "The quick" into the field labelled "Input" highlights the first 9 characters of the passage in green and the remaining characters in grey.
Typing "The quik" into the field labelled "Input" highlights the first 8 characters of the passage in red and the remaining characters in grey.
After typing the full passage "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" correctly, the timer stops, and the page displays "WPM: 12.0" and "Accuracy: 100.0%".
After a test completes with a score of "WPM: 12.0", clicking the button "Restart" clears the "Input" field, resets the timer to "00:00", and displays a new passage in the "Passage" field.

If the user types "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" with one typo (e.g., "The quikc..."), the final result shows "Accuracy: 95.8%" (calculated as correct characters / total characters * 100, rounded to one decimal).
The button "Pause" stops the timer. Clicking "Resume" continues the timer from the paused time.
Reload keeps the best score. After completing a test with "WPM: 15.0", reloading the page displays "Best WPM: 15.0" below the heading.
